protocol.duration: perf_counter around gather of scored requests only
protocol.ttft: first text-bearing event minus semaphore-admitted request start
protocol.throughput: successful completion token usage / scored duration

2b.scope: Historical open-source block-FP8 reference; not rerun with the current MXFP8 matrix

4b.scope: Historical open-source block-FP8 reference; not rerun with the current MXFP8 matrix

historical_validation.scope: Earlier native revisions; these precision records are not fresh qualification of the current throughput matrix

precision.metric: Gold-token raw-logprob MAE against the shared frozen BF16 M32 anchor; lower is better.
precision.coverage: M4/M32/M48/M64 use packaged production-geometry replay; M16/M24 reuse qualified diagnostic records and package generation parity. First-cohort repeat differences are zero.

actual_generation.high_row_behavior: Actual M48/M64 batches above 32 rows use the full BF16 head; smaller tails may use hybrid.

precision.m32_attribution: Fixed-token replay uses the complete BF16 head. Restoring FA2 with hybrid enabled reproduces all old M32 gold logprobs exactly; the +2.5771% MAE change is caused by the attention backend.
precision.interpretation: Numerical fidelity, not task accuracy or bitwise equivalence. Preserve per-shape MAE changes and equal-score ties.

quality.scope: fixed-M short raw decode gold logprobs; small FULL_AND_PIECEWISE; no PW2048; not production or task accuracy
fixed-M short raw decode gold logprobs; small FULL_AND_PIECEWISE; no PW2048; not production or task accuracy

cpu_combined_suite.scope: Image before final launcher cache-namespace change; other runtime sources unchanged

final_launcher_regression.scope: Final image, including repeated same-directory namespace and cache-flag handling

quality.reference: fresh same MXFP8 body, FP32 SSM, FlashInfer BF16 KV; KV only comparison
quality.metric: raw teacher-forced gold logprob MAE in nats, not task correctness

bootstrap.primary_random: mean errors from all three frozen calibration seeds, no selection
bootstrap.interval: 99% per comparison; exploratory secondary comparisons, no familywise significance claim

matched_length_control.purpose: Supplementary control added after detecting unequal calibration token budgets; deterministic training-only length metadata, no evaluation-content fit or score-driven scale selection

fresh.metric: original relative MAE change minus other group, percentage points

random_tokens.metric: original relative MAE change minus other group, percentage points

multimodal.scope: Same current MXFP8 language weights + pinned BF16 vision; same eager FlashInfer M1 engine and frozen scale policies for both groups. Not production Mach multimodal deployment.
multimodal.reference: Same complete model, only BF16 KV; FP32 SSM for all policies

bootstrap.unit: paired whole requests within each group; independent group draws for interaction
bootstrap.random: Mean of the errors from all three pre-frozen matched-length random banks; no seed selection

distribution_interaction.definition: Relative repo-vs-random MAE change on original minus that on multimodal; negative means stronger original advantage

multimodal.image_processing: All 392 original embedded images and all preceding messages retained; final assistant answer equal to output excluded, no manual resize/truncation; processor min_pixels=65536,max_pixels=262144
multimodal.invalidated_prior_csv_results: Old text slices and full-BF16 multimodal transfer passed the final assistant reply equal to output inside input. They are removed from reported results; final answer now excluded before chat templating.

leakage_assessment.direct_overlap: No overlap observed in audited source-ID/token boundaries for original/fresh/random-token text groups.
leakage_assessment.distribution_bias: Production text comparison: packaged advantage 4.27% on original, 3.96% on fresh; matched lengths: 3.37% vs 2.49%; interaction intervals include zero. Same-engine multimodal comparison: packaged advantage 0.045% on original, error increases 2.154% on multimodal; interaction -2.199 pp, 99% CI [-8.736,+4.460]. No statistically established original-specific advantage.
leakage_assessment.csv_prompt_leakage: The final assistant reply matched output in all selected requests. Earlier CSV results are invalidated. Corrected evaluation excludes that reply; all images retained and full target absent from remaining history. This is an evaluation-prompt defect, not evidence that KV scales fitted these answers.
leakage_assessment.scope: Numerical logprob fidelity, not task accuracy. Shared source-family structure, experiment selection, and distribution/length confounding cannot be excluded. No numerical probability of leakage is identified.
leakage_assessment.safe_precision_policy: Independent random-calibrated or all-1 scales. Historical bank is included only as a separate diagnostic.

limitations: One full trial per serving variant; no repeatable incremental gain established.
Three earlier kernel output discrepancies remain unresolved despite passing repeats.
Candidate versus previous response texts differ in 31/1040 2B and 34/1040 4B requests.
Unused fusion and RMSNorm PDL prototypes were removed after narrow gains and larger-batch regressions.

serving.protocol: Repository sixpoint protocol: 3000 input / 1000 output tokens; concurrency 4/16/24/32/48/64; 1040 scored requests per model/variant; fresh service per variant, one full suite each; prewarm and internal warmup excluded; single RTX 5090 TP1 per model; same GPU within each model; BF16 activations and SSM, 19 GiB KV; 2B TRITON_ATTN/BF16 KV/hybrid head; 4B FLASHINFER/FP8 KV/default compact greedy head; fusion and norm PDL excluded.
serving.execution_notes: The two models run concurrently on distinct GPUs; variants for each model run sequentially on the same GPU.

ssm_throughput.scope: Same-card stock BF16 versus ordered FP32 GDN; 2B BF16 KV, 4B FP8 KV; previous native binary; single trials

reporting: Per-concurrency throughput and gain only; no pooled or mean throughput

history_rewrite.scope: English PDL table headers only; all code blobs unchanged

baseline_recheck.protocol: Fresh services; sequential variants on the same GPU per model; grouped and GDN PDL flags disabled; production projection PDL unchanged
